diagnosed_root_causes.hypothesis: Manual workflows may limit reporting coverage and consume staff time

phase_1_actions.action: Audit duplicate handling, reporting effort, source coverage, and ownership.
Agree auditable outcome definitions with Finance. Separate staff time, hiring outcomes and estimated media cost.

phase_2_actions.action: Instrument verified tracking steps with source IDs and document staff time and conversion separately.
phase_2_actions.prerequisite: Complete the diagnostic and verify the proposed mechanism in this exact scope. Confirm missing or dependent observations against independent records. Specify the affected group and preserve the documented healthy baseline.
phase_2_actions.target_to_verify: In-Store Sales Associates and Assistant Store Managers (~110 urgent openings ahead of the seasonal peak)

phase_3_actions.condition: Expand after completeness, auditability and staff time improve.
phase_3_actions.prerequisite: Complete the scoped pilot and verify improvements and guard metrics.

open_questions_and_hypotheses_for_client.verify: Audit duplicate handling, reporting effort, source coverage, and ownership.

strengths: Base hourly pay for sales associates is actually 10% above the regional retail average (exit interviews almost never cite base pay), employees love the 40% staff product discount, and our Turin HQ design/merchandising teams maintain 92% annual retention.
cohort: HQ and our 12 city-center flagship stores hire smoothly and keep staff long-term. The real bleeding is concentrated in the 78 suburban mall stores, where 24% of newly hired sales associates quit within their first 6 months due to chaotic weekend rosters and newly promoted store managers with zero people-management training.
